raw_line: 4,[A sweeping low-angle crane shot descends from a surreal twilight sky painted in bruised purples and electric teal, revealing a vast alien landscape dominated by towering, obsidian-black mushroom stalks that pierce the misty atmosphere, while the camera begins a slow lateral dolly to the right, tracking the silhouette of an astronaut clad in a matte-black exosuit with segmented, carbon-fiber plating and faint amber LED status lights blinking rhythmically along the spine],[The astronaut pauses at the base of a colossal fungal structure, their gloved hand reaching out to gently brush away a layer of iridescent moss before carefully plucking a cluster of bioluminescent caps that pulse with a soft, rhythmic violet light, casting dynamic, shifting shadows across the textured, wet ground and the intricate leaf patterns of the surrounding flora],[As the astronaut turns slightly to examine the sample held in their palm, the camera executes a subtle rack focus pull, shifting sharpness from the distant, glowing horizon to the fine details of the suit's reflective visor and the delicate, trembling spores drifting upward from the collected mushroom into the cool air],[The ambient sound design features the muffled crunch of boot treads on damp soil and the faint, humming resonance of the alien ecosystem, while the camera continues its smooth tracking motion, keeping the figure centered as they navigate deeper into the dense, vibrant jungle where the interplay of artificial suit lights and natural bioluminescence creates a rich tapestry of deep greens, glowing blues, and shadowed blacks]
segments: A sweeping low-angle crane shot descends from a surreal twilight sky painted in bruised purples and electric teal, revealing a vast alien landscape dominated by towering, obsidian-black mushroom stalks that pierce the misty atmosphere, while the camera begins a slow lateral dolly to the right, tracking the silhouette of an astronaut clad in a matte-black exosuit with segmented, carbon-fiber plating and faint amber LED status lights blinking rhythmically along the spine

The astronaut pauses at the base of a colossal fungal structure, their gloved hand reaching out to gently brush away a layer of iridescent moss before carefully plucking a cluster of bioluminescent caps that pulse with a soft, rhythmic violet light, casting dynamic, shifting shadows across the textured, wet ground and the intricate leaf patterns of the surrounding flora

As the astronaut turns slightly to examine the sample held in their palm, the camera executes a subtle rack focus pull, shifting sharpness from the distant, glowing horizon to the fine details of the suit's reflective visor and the delicate, trembling spores drifting upward from the collected mushroom into the cool air

The ambient sound design features the muffled crunch of boot treads on damp soil and the faint, humming resonance of the alien ecosystem, while the camera continues its smooth tracking motion, keeping the figure centered as they navigate deeper into the dense, vibrant jungle where the interplay of artificial suit lights and natural bioluminescence creates a rich tapestry of deep greens, glowing blues, and shadowed blacks
segments_zh: 一张低角度的低角度起重机镜头从超现实的暮色天空中下降，漆成瘀伤的紫色和电青色，展现出广阔的外星景观，主要是高耸的黑曜石黑色蘑菇茎，刺破了迷雾的气氛，而摄影机开始向右缓慢横向移动，跟踪穿着哑光黑色外装服的宇航员的轮廓，外装带有分段碳纤维镀层和沿着脊柱有节奏地闪烁的琥珀色 LED 状态灯
宇航员在一个巨大的真菌结构的底部停下来，他们戴着手套的手伸出来轻轻地刷掉一层虹彩的苔藓，然后小心地拔掉一簇生物发光的菌盖，这些菌盖发出柔和、有节奏的紫光，在有纹理的潮湿地面和周围植物群复杂的叶子图案上投射动态、变化的阴影。
当宇航员轻轻转动以检查手掌中的样本时，相机会执行微妙的机架对焦拉动，将清晰度从远处发光的地平线转移到宇航服反光面罩的精细细节上，以及从收集到的蘑菇向上飘入凉爽空气中的精致颤抖的孢子
环境音效设计以靴子踩在潮湿土壤上的低沉嘎吱声和外星生态系统微弱的嗡嗡声为特色，而摄像机继续其平稳的跟踪运动，在他们深入茂密、充满活力的丛林时保持人物居中，在那里，人造套装灯和自然生物发光的相互作用创造了一幅由深绿色、发光蓝色和阴影黑色组成的丰富挂毯
